resources.string: Help us make messaging without a central point of control more reliable. Anonymous analytics and diagnostic logs are optional and can be changed in Settings.
Analytics never include messages, media, contacts, profile details, or keys. Diagnostic logs obscure identifiers and are securely sent to White Noise for troubleshooting.
Shares anonymous reliability, performance, and feature-use data to help improve White Noise. Messages, media, contacts, profile details, and keys are never included.
Sends sanitized technical activity to White Noise to help troubleshoot problems. Message content is excluded and identifiers are obscured.
This permanently removes all recorded diagnostic activity from this device. Your logging preference won’t change.
